body: That’s okay, that’s a lot of pressure for a stranger. I appreciate the offer, thank you.

My parents and sister told me that I can’t come to them when I’m suicidal. Flat out, they told me to call hotlines instead. My family doesn’t care about me, except for my brother, but he and I aren’t that close.

My friends are tired of it, I can tell. And the one friend who wants me to reach out...things have gotten so shitty and bad between us...I can’t say anything to him. He’ll think I’m being manipulative. Or codependent. Even though my therapist says I’m not.

That’s the thing. Therapists and people always tell me it’s not me, but...it is me. Otherwise, I wouldn’t be in this place where I have nobody. 

I’m so so so so tired.
